title: Automagik project toolchain manifest
description: What a project's gate needs, pinned so a per-project bootstrap can install it into that project's own volume. The common server image is never changed: the manifest travels with the project.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; the bootstrap ignores it.

version.description: An exact Bun release, without a leading v and without a range or tag.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the official Bun release zip, per Linux platform. Only platform hashes pinned here can be installed.

gate.description: The project's real gate. A native worker runs this command from the workspace with the bootstrap's bin directory on PATH.
